name: io.github.caiderek/logcarver-mcp
title: LogCarver
description: Read-only MCP server that finds deleted SQL Server rows from the transaction log (fn_dblog).

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVER_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
environmentVariables.description: SQL Server connection string. The login must be sysadmin (fn_dblog requires it). Example: Server=localhost;Database=MyDb;Integrated Security=true;TrustServerCertificate=true

environmentVariables.name: LOGCARVER_MCP_ALLOWED_DATABASES
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Extra databases the tool may read besides the one in the connection string, separated by commas or semicolons.
